reviewNotes: HOLD — GrSMU's official site presents a 2026/27 admission-testing page and an international applicant workflow, while the World Directory records a six-year English General Medicine/MD programme for foreign students after secondary education. The official tuition page is discoverable but the accessible content did not expose a current fee amount or fee year; an official hostel-fee item is explicitly for 2024/25. Current international fee, deadline, complete documents/eligibility, up-to-date accommodation cost and programme recognition evidence therefore remain insufficient for a publishable admissions page.
